keywords: 区块最坏大小与 gas 上限
summary: Nero 在 ethresear.ch 发文测算 Glamsterdam 规则下区块最坏大小：最大的区块来自零字节 calldata 加数千个被跳过的 EIP-7702 授权，60M gas 时约 1.8 MiB，他主张 EIP-8131 与 EIP-8279 一起上线并给 gas 上限设硬顶，以修复 FOCIL 的“能否追加”检查。配套的 PR #12686 让 EIP-8279 计量存款请求的 192 字节。EIP-7702 收到两处规范修订 PR，EIP-8151 作者回应为什么不做成可选预编译；kassandra 主张隐私协议提款走 4337 中继路径。

items.topic: 区块到底能有多大：gas 上限、字节上限与 FOCIL
items.title: PR #12686：EIP-8279 计量存款请求字节
items.note: 2026-11-22 13:50（nerolation）：Gloas 让 DepositRequests 成为无上限列表，每个请求给负载增加 192 字节，但 EIP-8131 和 EIP-8279 都不计量。中继合约循环调用存款合约，每笔约 26k gas，可以藏在零字节 calldata 的底价之下，把负载推到约 1.44 × gas_limit / 64（原本约 1.15×）。PR 规定存款合约发出带存款事件 topic 的 LOG 时计量 192 字节，与 EIP-6110 把日志转为请求的条件相同；正常存款的执行 gas（约 26k）远高于 12,288 的额外底价，不受影响。eth-bot 显示已获所有审阅者批准。
items.title_en: PR #12686: EIP-8279 meters deposit request bytes
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 13:50 (nerolation). Gloas made DepositRequests an unbounded list, and each request adds 192 bytes to the payload, yet neither EIP-8131 nor EIP-8279 meters them. A relay contract calling the deposit contract in a loop, at about 26k gas per deposit, can hide under the floor of zero-byte calldata and push the payload to about 1.44 × gas_limit / 64 instead of about 1.15×. The PR meters 192 bytes when the deposit contract emits a LOG with the deposit event topic, the same condition EIP-6110 uses to turn logs into requests. Normal deposits use about 26k execution gas, well above the 12,288 extra floor gas, so they are unaffected. eth-bot shows all reviewers have approved.

items.title: aelowsson 回复
items.note: 2026-11-23 00:57：EIP-7999 的思路是给每个 IL 分配区块数据上限的同等份额，用交易声明的数据上限来检查，这样数据上限独立约束信封，gas 上限可以继续提高；但数据资源同样要覆盖授权元组和请求，而声明数据上限需要新的交易格式。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-23 at 00:57. EIP-7999's approach gives each IL an equal share of the block's data limit, checked against transactions' declared data limits, so the data limit bounds the envelope independently and the gas limit can keep rising. The data resource would still need to cover authorization tuples and requests, and declaring a data limit needs a new transaction format.

items.topic: EIP-7702 与账户签名：规范修订、旧密钥风险和 PQ 迁移
items.title: PR #12685：EIP-7702 退款条件
items.note: 2026-11-22 12:41（tcoratger）：规范第 7 步说“authority 不为空”时退还 PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST - PER_AUTH_BASE_COST，而 Rationale 说“账户已存在于状态中”时退还。两者在“存在但为空”的账户上不同，参考实现按存在与否退款，PR 把第 7 步对齐到 Rationale。作者说明 EIP-7523 之后主网已没有这种账户，主网行为不变。
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 12:41 (tcoratger). Step 7 of the spec refunds PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST - PER_AUTH_BASE_COST "if authority is not empty", while the Rationale refunds it "if the account already exists in state". The two differ for an account that exists but is empty, and the reference implementation refunds by existence, so the PR aligns step 7 with the Rationale. The author notes that after EIP-7523 no such account exists on mainnet, so mainnet behavior does not change.
items.topic_en: EIP-7702 and account signatures: spec fixes, old key risk and PQ migration

items.topic: EIP-7702 与账户签名：规范修订、旧密钥风险和 PQ 迁移
items.title: PR #12689：EIP-7702 签名载荷
items.note: 2026-11-22 21:04（tcoratger）：规范写签名是对 keccak256(SET_CODE_TX_TYPE || TransactionPayload) 签的，而 TransactionPayload 末尾包含 signature_y_parity、r、s，字面上签名覆盖了自己。PR 改为像 EIP-1559、EIP-2930、EIP-4844 那样逐项列出不含签名的字段。两个 PR 都需要 7702 作者（adietrichs、lightclient、samwilsn、vbuterin）之一和一位编辑审核。
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 21:04 (tcoratger). The spec says the signature is over keccak256(SET_CODE_TX_TYPE || TransactionPayload), but TransactionPayload ends with signature_y_parity, r and s, so read literally the signature covers itself. The PR lists the signed fields explicitly without the signature, as EIP-1559, EIP-2930 and EIP-4844 do. Both PRs need review from one 7702 author (adietrichs, lightclient, samwilsn, vbuterin) and one editor.
items.topic_en: EIP-7702 and account signatures: spec fixes, old key risk and PQ migration

items.topic: EIP-7702 与账户签名：规范修订、旧密钥风险和 PQ 迁移
items.title: EIP-8151 作者回应
items.note: 2026-11-22 20:14（colinlyguo）：EIP-8151 让 ecRecover 遵循 EIP-3607 的账户代码限制（EIP-7702 委托指示符除外），并与 EIP-7851 的 0xef0101 停用授权对齐。对“做成可选预编译”的建议，作者说主要目标是 ERC-20 permit、Permit2 这类写死调用 0x01 的不可变合约；0x01 不变，退役的 ECDSA 密钥仍能通过这些合约转走资产。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-22 at 20:14 (colinlyguo). EIP-8151 applies the EIP-3607 account-code restriction to ecRecover (except for EIP-7702 delegation indicators) and aligns with EIP-7851's 0xef0101 deactivated authorities. On the suggestion of an opt-in precompile, he said the main targets are immutable contracts like ERC-20 permit and Permit2 that hardcode calls to 0x01. If 0x01 stays unchanged, retired ECDSA keys can still drain assets through those contracts.
items.topic_en: EIP-7702 and account signatures: spec fixes, old key risk and PQ migration

items.topic: EIP-7702 与账户签名：规范修订、旧密钥风险和 PQ 迁移
items.title: Vitalik 回复
items.note: PQ 迁移讨论：Vitalik 回复 2026-11-22 19:56：几乎所有非哈希签名方案在构造中也用到哈希，所以“只依赖曲线或格”不存在，选择只有“只依赖哈希”或“同时依赖哈希和别的东西”。gballet 11-23 04:59 认为，弄清楚如何升级以太坊的签名方案比决定具体方案更紧迫。decentrek 11-23 03:40 回答提问时说，EIP-8130 本身可以支持 PQ 签名，但 Base 还没说会支持 leanSPHINCS 还是其他方案（或都支持）。
items.note_en: PQ migration: Vitalik replied on 2026-11-22 at 19:56 that pretty much every non-hash-based signature scheme also uses hashes somewhere in its construction, so "depend only on curves or lattices" is not on the table. The choice is between depending only on hashes, or on hashes plus something else. gballet said at 11-23 04:59 that figuring out how to upgrade Ethereum's signature scheme is more urgent than choosing the specific scheme. decentrek answered a question at 11-23 03:40: EIP-8130 itself can support PQ signatures, but Base has not said whether it will support leanSPHINCS, another PQ scheme, or both.

items.topic: 隐私与账户抽象：4337 中继路径、Frame 交易隐私池和 Agent 账户安全
items.title: kassandra 谈 4337 隐私中继
items.note: 2026-11-22 20:18：隐私协议的提款和交易走 4337 中继路径意味着自由和选择，4337 打包是通用基础设施，很多服务都在打包 UserOp。她 20:33 补充：不想依赖协议专用中继的可用性、规则或费用，账户抽象就是出路，今天是 4337 打包，明天是 Frame 交易。
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 20:18: routing privacy protocol withdrawals and transactions through the 4337 relay path means freedom and choice, since 4337 bundling is general-purpose infrastructure and many services bundle UserOps. She added at 20:33 that if you do not want to depend on protocol-specific relayers being available, or on their rules and fees, account abstraction is the way out: 4337 bundling today, Frame transactions tomorrow.
items.topic_en: Privacy and account abstraction: the 4337 relay path, a Frame transaction privacy pool and agent account safety

items.title: kassandra 22:27
items.note: 与 anondotinc 的讨论中，kassandra 22:27 认为 4337 中继路径配合 paymaster 可以获得较强隐私；23:38 指出若不愿泄露“同一用户在移动 WETH（手续费）和其他资产”，可以用 ZK 证明手续费 UTXO，可行但增加 gas；11-23 00:02 补充 Railgun 的 unshield 总带有承诺的代币标记属性。
items.note_en: In a discussion with anondotinc, kassandra said at 22:27 that the 4337 relay path with a paymaster can give strong privacy. At 23:38 she noted that if leaking "the same user is moving WETH (the fee) plus other assets" is unacceptable, the fee UTXO can be ZK-proven, which works but adds gas. At 11-23 00:02 she added that Railgun unshields always carry this commitment token tagging property.

items.title: Frame 交易隐私池讨论新回复
items.note: 2026-11-22 19:27：原帖（11-06，Nethermind）在 Frame 交易上跑了 BN254 Groth16 隐私池，提款 679,322 gas、无需中继，但证明检查超过验证 gas 上限，池子也无法代表用户自己的地址发起调用。liamwilliams 认为 EOA 场景对身份绑定的操作是真实需求（领空投、投票委托、续费域名），但频率低且集中在领取事件，建议当作兼容性功能，先测量领取和投票流程再决定是否为此提高验证预算。
items.title_en: New reply on the Frame transaction privacy pool thread
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 19:27. The original post (11-06, Nethermind) ran a BN254 Groth16 privacy pool on Frame transactions with withdrawals at 679,322 gas and no relayer, but the proof check exceeds the validation gas cap and the pool cannot make a call from the user's own address. liamwilliams said the EOA case is real for identity-bound actions (claiming airdrops, voting or delegating, renewing names), but rare and concentrated around claim events, so it should be treated as a compatibility feature and claim and vote flows measured before raising the verify budget for it.

items.title: Secrypta 对 Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts 的评审
items.note: Agent 账户安全评审继续：Secrypta 对 Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts 的评审（11-22 17:32）指出，多数资金被盗并不改策略，而是走早先授予且未撤销的权限：ERC-20 allowance 或 permit、operator 授权、已安装的模块或 executor，对 7702 账户则是委托目标本身；建议证据层暴露 7579 executor 和当前 7702 委托目标。Zealynx 核查参考注册表（11-23 04:53）后确认 declare 在同一区块生效，签名者更换等于把策略放宽到任意，建议 declare 也要遵守最小延迟。
items.title_en: Secrypta's review of Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts
items.note_en: Agent account safety reviews continued. Secrypta's review of Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts (11-22 17:32) noted that most drains do not touch the policy at all. Funds leave through authority granted earlier and never revoked: ERC-20 allowances or permits, operator approvals, installed modules or executors, and for 7702 accounts the delegation target itself. Secrypta suggested the evidence layer expose 7579 executors and the current 7702 delegation target. Zealynx checked the reference registry (11-23 04:53) and confirmed that declare takes effect in the same block, so a signer swap is equivalent to loosening the policy to anything, and declare should respect the minimum delay too.

items.title: Zealynx 核查参考注册表
items.note: Agent 账户安全评审继续：Secrypta 对 Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts 的评审（11-22 17:32）指出，多数资金被盗并不改策略，而是走早先授予且未撤销的权限：ERC-20 allowance 或 permit、operator 授权、已安装的模块或 executor，对 7702 账户则是委托目标本身；建议证据层暴露 7579 executor 和当前 7702 委托目标。Zealynx 核查参考注册表（11-23 04:53）后确认 declare 在同一区块生效，签名者更换等于把策略放宽到任意，建议 declare 也要遵守最小延迟。
items.note_en: Agent account safety reviews continued. Secrypta's review of Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts (11-22 17:32) noted that most drains do not touch the policy at all. Funds leave through authority granted earlier and never revoked: ERC-20 allowances or permits, operator approvals, installed modules or executors, and for 7702 accounts the delegation target itself. Secrypta suggested the evidence layer expose 7579 executors and the current 7702 delegation target. Zealynx checked the reference registry (11-23 04:53) and confirmed that declare takes effect in the same block, so a signer swap is equivalent to loosening the policy to anything, and declare should respect the minimum delay too.

items.title: ERC-8507 Agent Allowlist Framework 发布 0.2.0
items.note: 2026-11-23 00:46：草案拿到编号并更名，按评审意见加入按动作声明的复用策略（NONE、WHILE_CURRENT、ADMISSION，默认 NONE）。此前 Secrypta（11-22 17:31）提醒：EIP-7702 账户可以随时重新委托，地址不变代码变，白名单条目应可选择锁定评估时的委托目标或代码哈希。
items.note_en: On 2026-11-23 at 00:46. The draft got its number and a new name, and following review it adds a per-action reuse policy (NONE, WHILE_CURRENT, ADMISSION, defaulting to NONE). Earlier, Secrypta (11-22 17:31) warned that an EIP-7702 account can re-delegate at any time, changing code without changing address, so an allowlist entry should optionally pin the delegation target or code hash it was assessed with.

items.title_en: EIP-8304 trustless log and transaction index
items.note_en: 2026-11-22 21:05: zsfelfoldi said validation adds about 1% to 2% of block processing time, a local index will ship soon as a Geth feature (replacing the filter maps index based on EIP-7745), and he is exploring ZK proofs of the index table roots so the protocol change could become optional. Impact: light clients and wallets could eventually query logs without trusting an RPC.

keywords_en: worst-case block size and gas limit
summary_en: Nero published an ethresear.ch analysis of the worst-case block size under Glamsterdam rules. The biggest block comes from zero-byte calldata plus thousands of skipped EIP-7702 authorizations, about 1.8 MiB at 60M gas, and he argues for shipping EIP-8131 and EIP-8279 together with a hard cap on the gas limit to fix FOCIL's "could have been appended" check. A companion PR #12686 makes EIP-8279 meter the 192 bytes of each deposit request. EIP-7702 picked up two spec fix PRs, the EIP-8151 author explained why an opt-in precompile would not work, and kassandra made the case for routing privacy protocol withdrawals through the 4337 relay path.
